name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 1 Basic — A Taste for Blood

system.description:
Every drop of vitae tells a story, and the sorcerers of the Path of Blood have learned to read it. A single stolen taste lays a stranger's secrets bare on the tongue.

Ingest a single Blood Trait from your subject to learn a few of their traits: how much vitae currently sits in their system (mortal or vampire), how recently a vampire has fed, their generation, and whether they are a diablerist (within the usual limits of detection time). No challenge is required, but because you must actually swallow the vitae you test, the power is dangerous if the blood is tainted or if you have already sampled that subject's blood. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
